questions.de: Welches populäre, urkapitalistische Brettspiel verbot Fidel Castro in Kuba kurz nach seiner Machtübernahme im Jahr 1959?
questions.en: Which popular, quintessentially capitalist board game did Fidel Castro ban in Cuba shortly after taking power in 1959?

timeline.labelEn: Fidel Castro orders all Monopoly sets in Cuba destroyed
timeline.labelDe: Fidel Castro lässt alle Monopoly-Spiele in Kuba vernichten

source.title: 90 years of Monopoly: how the 'new craze' morphed from socialist critique to capitalist dream

questions.notes: Widely repeated; the cited article says Castro 'famously ordered all Monopoly sets in Cuba destroyed in 1959'. A government substitute game, Capitolio, followed after 1961.

questions.notes: Card's statement (agent) is false. Since 2016 the £50,000 is shared equally between author and translator; before 2016 it was a career award to the author alone. Now called the International Booker Prize.
